label: Golf club breakfast menu (American breakfast)
note: One page (p2 of the PDF; p1 is a photo-only cover). A short menu — 19 items — with a busy photo background around a white panel. No restaurant name is printed anywhere on the page: correct restaurantName is null. 'The Berkeley' is a DISH, not the venue — returning it as the restaurant name is a failure. Traps: the omelette's build-your-own ingredient list is not a set of dishes; the overall title 'Breakfast Menu' is the only heading over the main items. Useful for the omelet question in plan.md (should a restaurant omelette ever be green?).

source.kind: restaurant website PDF, rendered to JPEG at 1600px; pages [2] of the original

dishes.name: The Berkeley*
dishes.description: Two eggs any style with a choice of three bacon strips or two sausage patties, a choice of hash browns, grits or fruit and a choice of toast, English muffin or biscuit

dishes.name: Omelette*
dishes.description: Build your own Omelette. Choose any three of the following items: Bacon • Ham • Sausage • Mushrooms • Onions • Peppers • Spinach • Tomatoes • Salsa • Shredded Cheddar Cheese. Served with a choice of hash browns, grits or fruit and a choice of toast, English muffin or biscuit

dishes.name: Breakfast Burrito*
dishes.description: Two eggs scrambled with onions, peppers, sausage and cheddar cheese wrapped in a flour tortilla and served with salsa and choice of hash browns, grits or fruit

dishes.name: The Egg Sandwich*
dishes.description: Two eggs any style, bacon or sausage patty, and choice of cheese. Served on choice of 8 grain, white, marble rye bread, biscuit or English muffin

dishes.name: Pastrami Hash with Eggs*
dishes.description: Corned beef hash and two eggs any style with choice of toast, biscuit or English muffin

dishes.name: Belgian Waffles
dishes.description: Made to order waffle sprinkled with powdered sugar served with butter and maple syrup

dishes.name: Pancakes
dishes.description: A stack of three pancakes served with butter and your choice of honey or maple syrup

dishes.name: Knife & Fork Fried Chicken Biscuit
dishes.description: Fried chicken breast on buttermilk biscuit, topped with gravy

dishes.name: French Toast
dishes.description: Two thick slices of Texas toast dipped in a cinnamon and nutmeg flavored batter then sautéed until golden brown with a dusting of powdered sugar

answerKey.how: Blind tier calls on a sample via the Menu Tier Calls page (app score revealed only after each pick). Sugar counts for drinks and desserts (Ray's call, 2026-10-04). Mango sticky rice was revised after the reveal and restored to Ray's first call; near-identical Thai dishes unified on Ray's instruction.
